ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); do not pay the driver the $4.50 for this cancellation; remind the driver that the "I'm Here" / waiting-fee buttons are only to be used when GPS confirms he is at the pick-up point, and send this cancellation for driver-account review.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's no-show claim not established on the system record: the app never confirmed arrival (arrival_confirmed_by / arrival_radius_m / wait_started_at / wait_expired_at all null), so the required confirmed wait of >3 minutes at the pick-up point (NS-1 (iii)) is not evidenced; the driver_arrived_at of 18:21:00 also conflicts with the GPS trace, which shows him ~150 m away and still moving at that time.
Route-deviation clause does not apply — trip was cancelled before pick-up, there is no gps-detour segment; the driver's 90-day profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0.
